Browser PDF dependencies, bundled locally

pdf-lib 1.17.1, MIT License
https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib
File: pdf-lib.min.js from the configured Codex workspace dependency bundle.
License: pdf-lib-LICENSE.txt

@pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1, MIT License
https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit
File: fontkit.umd.min.js from https://unpkg.com/@pdf-lib/fontkit@1.1.1/dist/fontkit.umd.min.js
License: fontkit-LICENSE.txt

All files are local. Opening or exporting bookmarks makes no requests to a CDN.
